description: Add a Hono API route to Greenhouse: core route under apps/api/src/routes (endpoint comment block, chained new Hono<AppEnv>(), guards, db services, one line in mountRoutes) or a plugin route under plugins/<id>/api (defineExtension routes on /api/ext/<id>, or a dataSource instead of hand-written CRUD), then tests. Use for: add an endpoint / API / route, 加个接口, 新增 API, 加条路由, 写个 endpoint. Red lines: chain the definition (statement-style drops it from AppType), no any in a response, never reorder mountRoutes, plugins import only @greenhouse/api/extension-kit.
